title: Heavy Perfume-Like Smell Right Out of the Package
text:
Heavy Perfume-Like Smell Right Out of the Package. Oh my gosh, I am not exaggerating. As soon as I opened up the package I was hit with a strong perfume smell from the product. Maybe perfume combined with laundry detergent smell. The scent permeated the entire room. I kid you not. It was so powerful, so annoying, and so unnecessary.

I couldn't take it. And because Amazon would have just said wash the darn thing to get the smell out, I would have had to pay the shipping to return it.

I was so disappointed and upset that this company would perfume the mattress cover, and because the smell was overwhelming me, I just immediately threw it away in the outside garbage bin.

I have no idea why this company would think people want a heavily perfumed mattress pad, especially knowing there are many people sensitive to smells. (The scent was making me cough.)
